title: Owner Auto Policy Underwriting Rule — Cancellation for Underwriting Reasons
content:
**Within the new-business underwriting period.** On the Owner Auto Policy, an underwriting cancellation for a reason not on the list of reasons that survive the period is processed no later than the garaging state's new-business underwriting period after the original effective date of the policy.
- Calendar days are counted from the original effective date of term 1 as day 0, using the garaging state's figure.
- Processing on the last day of the period qualifies.

**After the period.** An in-force policy is cancelled for underwriting only for a reason on that list: the named insured's license suspended or revoked, or material misrepresentation on the application.

**Advance notice.** The cancellation effective date is at least the garaging state's underwriting notice days after the mailing date of the underwriting cancellation notice. This is read from the notice's mailing date and the effective date it states.

**Premium and fees.** Unearned premium is returned pro rata. Fees are not returned.

**Not an underwriting cancellation.** Nonpayment is never handled as an underwriting cancellation.

**Period boundary (hypothetical, Ohio, 90 days).**

| Original effective date | Processing date | Any underwriting reason allowed |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | day 90 | Yes |
| 1 March | day 91 | Only a surviving reason |
